name: jato-ai-bid-management
author: 佳图数科
description: Jato AI BID 局域网授权与运维统计管理端

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:initial-admin && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,magenta "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron ."
scripts.dev:inspect: npm run prepare:initial-admin && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,magenta "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron --remote-debugging-port=9223 ."
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:initial-admin && npm run build && node scripts/build-win.cjs
